# carrier type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:carrierType`](gmeow-carrierType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/carrierType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence`](../../slices/archaeological-evidence.md)

The archaeological or cultural-heritage classification of a physical carrier — a value vocabulary individual from [`gmeow:PhysicalCarrierType`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalCarrierType.md). Non-functional: a carrier may be classified plurally by different standpoints ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
